name: cyber-aware-creations
description: Eight NIST-aligned skills for security leaders, running locally against your own files. Six own data and persist it: risk-register scores and tracks a cybersecurity risk register with change history and board dashboards; nist-csf assesses your programme against NIST CSF 2.0 as a tracked Organizational Profile with gap analysis, coverage reporting and read-only crosswalks to ISO 27001, CIS Controls and 800-53; metrics-register trends security metrics and KRIs with direction-aware thresholds; exceptions-register runs the lifecycle of accepted risks and control exceptions and exports the evidence artifact an auditor asks for; incident-materiality structures an SEC Item 1.05 and DORA disclosure determination and its clocks, and never emits a verdict; business-context records the organisation's own facts — revenue base, crown jewels, board-voiced tolerance — and the applicability profile that lets every other skill ask only the questions that apply. ciso-board-translation owns the board-facing language they all call, with sourced regulatory receipts. board-pack assembles the quarterly pack as a print-ready document and an editable PowerPoint deck, and owns no data at all.

interface.shortDescription: NIST-aligned risk register, CSF 2.0 profile, metrics, exceptions, incident materiality, business context, and the board pack they assemble into
interface.longDescription: Eight composable skills for the people accountable for security, running locally against your own files. Keep a NIST-aligned risk register with NISTIR 8286 event statements, deterministic Likelihood x Impact scoring, SP 800-30 banding, risk-appetite flagging and an append-only change log (risk-register). Track your programme against NIST CSF 2.0 as an Organizational Profile with computed gap analysis, coverage rollups and crosswalk lenses onto ISO 27001, CIS Controls and 800-53 (nist-csf). Trend metrics and KRIs with direction-aware thresholds (metrics-register). Run accepted risks and control exceptions through a re-validation lifecycle that refuses a record with no approver or justification (exceptions-register). Structure an incident materiality determination and its SEC Item 1.05 and DORA clocks, with no score and no verdict, because that judgment is made with counsel (incident-materiality). Record the organisation's own facts and the applicability profile that narrows what every other skill asks (business-context). Translate any metric, risk or quarter into board-ready language with sourced regulatory receipts (ciso-board-translation). Assemble it all into a quarterly board pack and an editable PowerPoint deck (board-pack). Not affiliated with or endorsed by NIST.
